comment.body: Thanks for the elevation state and the steps showing that the setting was unchecked. Please fully exit PowerToys from the tray, then launch it from an ordinary non-administrator Start menu or Explorer window (not an elevated terminal), and confirm whether Settings still reports Running as administrator. This separates a retained/inherited elevated token from a startup-preference defect; no full registry or settings export is needed.
